verdict.rationale: ReadMe's docs describe hosting docs on your own company domain, set up from Configuration > Custom Domain. They cover CNAME setup, apex domains versus subdomains, and SSL certificates, which delivers the custom-domain half of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of serving docs as a /docs subpath of the main site (e.g. reverse proxy support), plan requirements for custom domains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
